plugin.description:
Alpha.

Submarine-focused fork of AutoRetainer. Manages unlocking, levelling and profit routes for your submersibles across characters, sells submarine salvage at the Limsa vendor (needs Lifestream and vnavmesh), runs Salvage Mode on the MultiMode loop, and sends gil from your alts to a host character that runs OrangeJuice Host.

Plugin from https://pfa.marobotic.dev/repo/
plugin.summary: Automatic submarine management, from the comfort of your bed.
